ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Individual research in an area of materials science and engineering under the supervision of members of the staff. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Grade point average of 3.0 and consent of instructor.
